description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes for the 3GPP TS ASN1 NRPPA protocol, including message types, procedures, and object sets related to 5G positioning and measurement procedures.

classes.name: nr_ppa_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Object set of NRPPA elementary procedures, including various request, response, and failure message structures.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Sequence representing an initiating message with procedure code, transaction ID, and procedure content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Sequence representing a successful response message with procedure code, transaction ID, and response content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Sequence representing a failure response message with procedure code, transaction ID, and failure details.

classes.name: nr_ppa_pdu_c
classes.description: Choice type representing the top-level protocol data unit, which can be an init message, successful outcome, or unsuccessful outcome.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of the procedure or message.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the structure into JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads object data based on procedure code.
